description: Synthetic operational signals for a fictional regional logistics network. All sites, suppliers and events are invented.

signals.title: Reefer R-17 temperature excursion of +9C for 47 minutes
signals.summary: Reefer unit R-17 in bay K3 reported a sustained temperature excursion of +9C above setpoint for 47 minutes before recovering.

signals.title: Automatic quality hold on temperature-sensitive pallets in bay K3
signals.summary: The warehouse system placed 22 temperature-sensitive pallets in bay K3 on quality hold after the R-17 excursion.

signals.title: Shift lead reports compressor noise on reefer R-17
signals.summary: Night shift lead reports intermittent grinding noise from the R-17 compressor and frost build-up on the evaporator.

signals.title: SUP-305 backorders compressor part C-55 for three weeks
signals.summary: Supplier SUP-305 announced a three week backorder on compressor part C-55 used in the R-series reefer units.

signals.title: Berth wait at Orlin terminal 2 extended to 36 hours
signals.summary: Vessel arrival data shows average berth wait at terminal 2 rising from 8 to 36 hours over two days.

signals.title: Customs inspection backlog holds 140 containers
signals.summary: The customs inspection queue at Orlin holds 140 containers, 31 of them bound for the network.

signals.title: Gale warning for Orlin approaches for the next 48 hours
signals.summary: Marine forecast issues a gale warning for the Orlin approaches, pilot boarding may be suspended.

signals.title: Drayage partner reports 40 percent truck shortfall

signals.title: Inbound loads from Orlin running 18 hours behind notice
signals.summary: Advance shipping notices from Orlin are running 18 hours behind on average at the Varden cross-dock.

signals.title: SUP-214 issues force majeure notice on resin grade R2
signals.summary: Supplier SUP-214 declared force majeure on resin grade R2 deliveries for the next 30 days.

signals.title: Resin R2 stock cover down to 6 days at Tamsk
signals.summary: On-hand resin R2 at the Tamsk distribution center covers 6 days of planned outbound volume.

signals.title: Spot price index for resin R2 up 22 percent week on week
signals.summary: The procurement feed shows the resin R2 spot index up 22 percent week on week, consistent with a supply shock.

signals.title: Unverified report of fire near the air cargo apron
signals.summary: A driver radioed an unverified report of smoke near the Isen air cargo apron. No alarm has been raised.

signals.title: Driver reports detour adds 3 hours to Varden-Tamsk
signals.summary: A driver reports the signed detour around the river road adds about 3 hours per trip.
